title: Custom Combat Mod
description: This mod adds new attacks and settings
body:
**Custom Combat Mod**

A Minecraft Forge mod that enhances combat with custom martial arts attacks. The mod adds two special combat moves with unique animations and mechanics:

**Features:**

Punch Attack (Default: F key) - A basic punch with 2.0 damage and 4.0 block range
Kick Attack (Default: V key) - A powerful kick with 4.0 damage and 3.5 block range, featuring strong knockback

**Key Features:**

Custom animations for both attacks
Fully configurable key bindings through Minecraft's controls menu
Network synchronization for multiplayer compatibility
Client-side configuration with Forge's config system
Configuration: All settings are accessible through:

In-game controls menu (Settings → Controls → Key Bindings → Custom Combat Mod category)
The mod integrates seamlessly with Minecraft's existing combat system while adding new tactical options for players who prefer close-quarters combat.
